description.zh-CN: 显示在首页话题列表上方。留空则隐藏中文提示条。
description.en-US: Shown above the homepage topic list. Leave empty to hide the Chinese notice.

default: 真诚、友善、团结、专业，共建你我引以为荣的社区。
recommendedValue: 真诚、友善、团结、专业，共建你我引以为荣的社区。

description.zh-CN: 英文界面下的提示条文案。留空则隐藏。
description.en-US: Notice copy for English UI. Leave empty to hide.

default: Be sincere, friendly, united, and professional as we build a community we are proud of.
recommendedValue: Be sincere, friendly, united, and professional as we build a community we are proud of.

description.zh-CN: 首页无话题时的主标题。留空则使用主题内置文案。
description.en-US: Main title when the homepage has no topics. Leave empty to use built-in copy.

description.zh-CN: 英文界面下空列表主标题。留空则使用内置文案。
description.en-US: Empty-list title for English UI. Leave empty for built-in copy.

description.zh-CN: 首页无话题时的说明文字。留空则使用主题内置文案。
description.en-US: Description when the homepage has no topics. Leave empty for built-in copy.

description.zh-CN: 英文界面下空列表说明。留空则使用内置文案。
description.en-US: Empty-list description for English UI. Leave empty for built-in copy.

description.zh-CN: 关闭后桌面端首页不渲染右侧辅助栏（热帖/统计/标签等）。
description.en-US: When off, the desktop homepage hides the right rail (hot topics, stats, tags).

description.zh-CN: 在右侧栏展示按回复数排序的热门讨论。
description.en-US: Show hot discussions sorted by reply count in the right rail.

description.zh-CN: 在右侧栏展示主题/回复/分类/标签数量。
description.en-US: Show topic, reply, category, and tag counts in the right rail.

description.zh-CN: 在右侧栏展示可点击筛选的热门标签。
description.en-US: Show clickable popular tags in the right rail.

description.zh-CN: 访客显示登录注册，已登录显示用户快捷入口。
description.en-US: Guests see login/register; signed-in users see profile shortcuts.

description.zh-CN: 右侧栏热门讨论最多展示几条（3–15）。
description.en-US: Maximum hot topics in the right rail (3–15).

description.zh-CN: 右侧栏热门标签最多展示几个（3–20）。
description.en-US: Maximum popular tags in the right rail (3–20).

description.zh-CN: 右侧栏访客登录卡下的说明。留空使用主题内置文案。
description.en-US: Copy under the guest login card. Leave empty for built-in copy.

description.zh-CN: 英文界面下访客登录卡说明。留空使用内置文案。
description.en-US: Guest login card copy for English UI. Leave empty for built-in copy.

description.zh-CN: 关闭后左侧导航不显示「发新帖」入口（仍可通过其它入口发帖）。
description.en-US: When off, hide the compose button in the left nav (other entry points still work).

description.zh-CN: 在分类名称旁显示话题数量。
description.en-US: Show topic counts next to category names.

description.zh-CN: 关闭后默认主题布局不渲染页脚（版权与友链区域）。
description.en-US: When off, the default theme layout hides the footer (copyright and friend links).

description.zh-CN: 关闭后不渲染主题公告条组件（公告数据仍由后台管理）。
description.en-US: When off, hide the theme announcement banner (announcements are still managed in admin).
